comments.value:
It sucks cause I noticed that issue when testing the Open Beta branch, I honestly thought they would fix that before pulling that update to everyone,

I was alright with all formers update but this one I got a very bad opinion of it;

Wrist Angle like you said is different, it infuriates me a lot because even trying to re-adjust the wrist angle in the existing slider setting, it's not entirely perfect because it is offset on the position.

Default triggers sensitivity on quest touch controllers are WAY too high (70% pressed) which makes hard for peoples to press buttons on the UI.

Radial Menu prevents you to move unless you have One Handed Mode enabled.

If there was a way to revert to the previous version I would gladly do.

comments.mergedPostDetails:
Since the recently introduced Steam VR Input 2.0 update was applied, the avatar's hand angle has been tilted inward on the Valve Index controller.

There is no change when Legacy Fingers is turned on.

The avatar's hand angle can be changed in the VRChat settings, but not the twist or left/right adjustment, so this cannot be resolved by changing the settings.

This problem was observed in OpenBeta and reported as a Feature Request, but it was never improved.
